knownGaps: The race detector cannot start on this Windows host (TSan shadow-memory allocation, error code 87). Concurrency is covered by the real-MySQL contender tests; the race gate is left to CI on Linux.

Concurrent same-tenant ProvisionTenant calls can still collide while creating roles (read-then-insert) before reaching the idempotent grant code. Normal provisioning is serialized per tenant creation and repair runs are sequential.

replaceRolePermissions and replaceUserRoles still delete-then-insert; they do not pre-check and their inputs are deduplicated, so a conflict requires a concurrent writer on the same role/user, which is not a supported workflow.
